name: NE Couloir
itinerary: Single day, ideally with an early (pre-dawn or early-morning) start to catch firm snow: drive to Tiffany Springs Campground, hike ~45 min to Honeymoon Pass, traverse to the cirque, climb the couloir, then walk off via the NW ridge and Little Tiffany Lake trail — roughly 5 hours round-trip per the first-ascent report.
descent_text: From the top of the couloir on the summit ridge, walk off via Tiffany's northwest ridge, then drop to the old unmaintained trail above Little Tiffany Lake, following it down to rejoin trail #373 near Honeymoon Pass and retracing the approach back to Tiffany Springs Campground. The first-ascent party reported approximately 5 hours round-trip from the trailhead.
